sub6014: The alarm beeps, it's 10am.
Emily groans, hitting snooze and pushing her knotted hair off of her face.
She sits as she remembers that it's been one month, 30 days, since she broke up with Adam, her ex boyfriend.
She leans back and shoves her face where there are damp snot-covered tissues from the last night.
She feels something cold touching her feet and eyes down from her bed to see the teddy bear that Adam had gifted her. She was certain that she stashed it into the closet.
Her gaze falls upon the piano that's sitting in a dark corner and reminds her of the times that she played it together with Adam.
Then her phone rings and it's her best friend Lex.
She answers the call and Lex wishes her a happy monthiversary I think.
Emily throws her phone, a click sounds and Lex hangs up. Emily thought that Lex wasn't done.
Lex called again and made fun of Emily because of her sob party last night I think.
Then said she'll be over in 5 and hang up.
Emily went under the sheets and 5 minutes later she heard a thump, sat up and went to investigate as it happened again.
She saw a yellow blur through the window and noticed the top of Lex's blonde head and her signature blue and pink highlights.

She glanced at the mirror next to the door to see herself with her knotted hair and her My Little Pony shirt back from elementary school. She slid into her fluffy slippers and stood in front of the mirror I think.
Maybe then she thought about her shirt. She tried to spice her look up by wearing her sunglasses, went two stairs down and opened the door.
Leaning back at her car's hood Lex looked at her. Emily complained that what Lex was doing is vandalism and noticed some Peanut M&M's on the ground.
Lex then said something about trying some since it's probably been a long time.
Emily thought that it was true it's been two years since she's had some because Adam is deadly allergic to nuts.
Lex had already ripped open one of the packages and eaten a handful.
Emily decided to open them and placed one on her tongue to melt. She thought that it was nice.
Then Lex said something about getting her ready and she followed Emily inside.
When in her room she snuck her pierced nose inside Emily's closet, picked two dresses, one red and one white, and threw them at Emily, raising her eyebrow.
Emily thought that the white one would stain and the red one reminded her of her first date with Adam.
Memories of a gazebo, a violin and a 5 o'clock shadow of Adam.
She wore it, grabbed Lex's keys from her bedside table and ran outside with Lex insulting her shortly behind her.
She got in the driver's seat of Lex's car and went and parked in front of Adam's blue house.
Lex told her this is a bad idea and that she's legally obliged to take care of Emily and make sure she doesn't do something stupid.
Emily opened the door and Lex grabbed her hand.
Emily had seen Adam by his window next to a curved woman figure.
She shook off Lex's grip and reassured her that she was just going to take a closer look.
She sneaked and went closer she couldn't see a thing.
She quickly went across a path of garden flamingos and reached under the window.
Then she thought it was indeed a bad idea she kicked a rock and made a sharp noise that broke the garden gnome that Adam's grandma had gifted to him.
Emily squatted and tried to make a pile of the broken pieces.
As she did that a sharp piece cut through a finger of her right hand.
She stood up and screamed looking at it.
Adam appeared with a lady next to him calling Emily and asking her what she was doing there.
Emily thought that the lady had nice blond curls and nice cheekbones. She thought that she was pretty.
Emily confronted Adam about being with a tinder girl one month after their breakup.
Now I remembered that back when she was alone at home she thought it was time for a change bit her lip and tapped the Tinder app.
First thing was a smirking guy with some chiseled jawline I think that she swiped left immediately.
The next profile was of Adam and she left-swiped thinking "not in a million years".
Her cheeks got flushed because she thought about an imaginary scenario where he swipes right to her.

Back to the story outside Adam's house Adam wrinkled his face the girl next to him goes "o" faced and then clarifies that she is his cousin and that she was just about to leave. She pointed at her van, waved at Emily and left.
Emily couldn't see Adam eye-to-eye then he said something and Emily said that she missed him.
He proposed that they go grab a coffee she nodded and agreed he went into his car she sat next to him noticed the scent of campfire Adam put his favorite Eminem album on.
They reached to the go-to coffee shop near the college campus Firefly Cafe.
They went inside, she noticed the hunched people studying sitting next to the windows with their headphones on.
Adam goes to sit at a table I think and she goes to the counter to order.
A familiar face talks to her and asks her to film him handing her his phone after she nodded.
He then gets his ukulele out of a bag sits on one knee in front of a girl plays the intro of a Marry Me song and sings till the chorus.
The woman's eyes open wider and she covers her mouth. She then hugs his neck and everyone in the store cheers and claps.
Then Emily noticed a dog trying to enter the shop.
She decided to try and help it risking ruining the video but another customer enters and so does the pug that approaches the man.
Then he gets a wedding ring that's on the dog's collar and puts it on one of the woman's finger.
Shortly after she stopped filming handed the phone back and congratulated them with a smile.
The smiling man thanked her happily.
Then Emily went to the bartender and ordered after she thought about the contradiction between her life and theirs.
There was a man with muscly tattooed arms and black eyes with nice eyelashes.
She ordered two special regulars I think.
He questioned that she was a regular then she asked for two iced lattes I think.
Then he reassured her that her first order is ok and she handed him 5$.
She went to sit with Adam then he got a card deck out of his jacket. Emily thought of the rules of the game they were about to play.
She chose the Queen of Hearts Adam wanted the card but then chose the ace of spades.
Then he shuffled the deck and flipped the top card
It was a queen of hearts card. Then Emily thought that the "queen of hearts" in the room is the girl that got proposed to.
Then Adam talked about how he was doing and that he moves forward professionally while Emily thought that all this time she wasted sobbing about the breakup.
Now it's the time she said that she missed him actually and he looks alienated.
She then tears up the guy behind the counter comes to serve their coffees places one on the table and looks at Emily
then another employee enters the shop and calls for him Ryan and as he looks and puts down the second coffee down some of it is spilled on Adam's shirt.
He then proceeds to act like a man-child and threatened to call for the manager while Adam apologized.
Adam stormed out to return home and then asked Emily if she needs a ride
she said she had Lex. Which was a lie.
Then she left passed some huge Starbucks line and 10 minutes later she was outside Lex's place a three-story building.
Emily knocked and Lex was there
then she opened and judged quietly.
Then said that they are going to a fraternity party and did Emily's makeup.
They arrived there with Lex's car and there was a sticky floor an ongoing beerbong game and some people dancing.
Lex went and hugged a group of girls
one of them approached Emily and called her Adam's girlfriend. Emily corrected her with "ex"

then the girl whispered to Emily that Lex didn't ever approve of their relationship. Then when people needed a participant for the game that Lex played Emily volunteered and drew a snake on a wall which Lex guessed correctly.
Then Emily took her friend and confronted her about what she just learned.
Lex was honest and said that a better choice for Emily was Ryan that Emily had set in the same group with other famous Ryans that she found hot before.
He was gazing at the stars holding on to some stairs railings.
Emily tried to leave but something happened and the two of them got to talk.
Emily said something about him spilling his drink again (he was holding a cup with drink) and they sat there talking for 3 hours.
Ryan tried to make a move at her with his hand (he had shown signs that he likes her before)
but she pulled back and explained that she is not ready.
She asked for his number when she thought about it again
but he realized that she could take months to get over her ex and left.
Then Emily thought and realized that she could've tried to heal instead of sob all this time.

She took Lex to her place, got her on the couch with a blanket, went to her room, got on her toes, got the box filled with memories of paper and polyester full of memories of her past relationship and threw the box out.
Then she went and turned the dusty piano on and started playing with her eyes closed as the next day approached. The first day of her new life.
